generate_gmock_classes: generate Google Mock classes for all C++ classes in a header file
generate_gmock_specific_class: generate a Google Mock class for a specific C++ class named MyClass
generate_mock_virtual_methods: generate MOCK_METHOD macros for all virtual non-ctor methods in a C++ class
generate_mock_templated_class: generate a Google Mock class for a templated C++ class with template arguments
generate_mock_namespaced_class: generate a Google Mock class for a C++ class inside a namespace
